details: Upstream Nangate45 models (synth/nangate45_upstream.v) contain specify blocks in 125/134 cells with $setuphold checks; SDF (synth/mcu.sdf) generated successfully with 11,856 cells, 67,377 IOPATHs, 3,344 timing checks, all non-zero delays.
Icarus emits: 'warning: Omitting $sdf_annotate() since specify blocks are being omitted.' at compile time.
Direct tests prove specify path delays do not affect simulation: a (a => y) = 5.0 specify block on a NOT gate shows y changing immediately (3ns after input, not 5ns).

Verified with TWO independent Icarus 12.0 builds: Ubuntu package 12.0-2build2 AND upstream v12_0 built from source (github.com/steveicarus/iverilog, built 2026-10-09). Both exhibit identical behavior.
Tested across Verilog standards (-g1995, -g2005, -g2005-sv, -g2012) and with both gate primitives and continuous assignments. Specify delays never apply.
Verilator (only other simulator available) does not support SDF/specify delays (cycle-based, ignores timing).
evidence: tb/tb_gate_sdf.sv (testbench, not run due to blocker)
tb/run_gate_sdf.sh (runner with fail-closed SDF audit, not run due to blocker)
/tmp/spec2.v, /tmp/pure_spec.v, /tmp/spec95.v (specify delay tests, all show no delay)
blocker.summary: Icarus Verilog 12.0 cannot simulate specify path delays, making SDF back-annotation impossible.

declared_abstractions: behavioral SRAM/ROM (rtl/sram.sv, rtl/bootrom.sv) substituted for blackbox stubs, zero-delay (same as F2/F3)
note: F4 BLOCKED is a tool limitation, not a design failure. The 31/31 PASS contract (v1.0.1) is unaffected. SDF infrastructure (generator, models, testbench) is complete and committed for future use with a capable simulator.
